scope: Per-window opening request identity, close/reset invalidation, cooperative streaming decode cancellation and suppression of stale renderer responses.

before.assertion: None -> None must still cancel the old open

regression.note: The initial regression exercised the real close registry before opening-request invalidation was connected. The final suite also pauses a real generated-WAV decoder and cancels it through registry close.

browser.runner: Headless Playwright CLI on localhost mock, explicit reload between six scenarios

passed: late success cannot clear reset loading
stale error cannot restore previous track
newer opening remains loading until its own response
prepare then explicitly accept without decoding
occupied UI rejects a second offer
duplicate token does not cancel its pending transfer
committed reload recovers from an unconsumed URL token
unowned source is never discarded or decoded
source unmount without closing native session

limits: Cancellation is cooperative at decoded block boundaries; an individual OS read or decoder packet is not forcibly interrupted.
Generated fixtures and mock IPC only; no user library, audio devices or real Tauri OS-window smoke test.
No new process RSS or WebKit memory measurement in this stage.
